description: List supplier invoices (leverantörsfakturor) with paging and a raw query filter. For unpaid supplier debt by age use bokio_open_items on account 2440.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

name: bokio_list_supplier_invoices
